shared_elements: upright slab/stele with figural carving on a broad face
carved decoration divided into upper and lower zones
curvilinear/looped motifs in the lower field
a rounded/disc-like element within the composition
raised or incised border framing the field
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing carved motifs organised into an upper and lower field, with some looping curvilinear forms and a rounded disc-like element, but these are generic to almost any carved stele tradition. A depicts a specific narrative scene of a quadruped with riders and small human figures above an interlaced ship-like/knotwork panel, all bounded by bands of repeated sign-marks, whereas B shows a broad-shouldered anthropomorphic form with schematic arcs, a plain ring and belt-like bands and no figural narrative, animals or sign-bands.
